::: {#def-inorder}
#### Inorder

The **inorder** $\operatorname{inorder}(T)$ of a binary tree $T$ (@def-binary-tree) [@wikipedia_tree_traversal]
is the list (@def-list) of the labels of its vertices defined recursively by

$$
\ba
\operatorname{inorder}(\mathtt{nil}) &= \mathtt{empty},
\\ \operatorname{inorder}\paren{\operatorname{node}(x, L, R)} &= \operatorname{app}\paren{\operatorname{inorder}(L), \operatorname{cons}\paren{x, \operatorname{inorder}(R)}}.
\ea
$$

The root comes between its left subtree and its right subtree.

:::
